sections.title: State whether the following statements are True or False.

questions.q: Croissants are made from leavened puff dough.
Danish pastry is made from a yeast puff dough.

questions.answer: False. They are usually ring shaped (cut with a doughnut cutter).

We cannot store brioche dough in a refrigerator as yeast will die.
questions.answer: False. Brioche dough can be stored for a day or two in the refrigerator.

questions.q: Richer yeast doughs require longer time for fermentation.

sections.title: Answer the following questions (five points each).

questions.q: What is a starter dough? Why is it prepared?
questions.answer: (i) A starter dough is a small soft dough made by dissolving yeast in lukewarm milk and adding a little flour. (ii) It is kept covered in a warm place for about 30 minutes until it doubles in volume. (iii) It is then mixed into the rest of the dough. (iv) It makes the yeast active and gives richer doughs like brioche and croissant a good rise, flavour and texture. (v) Such doughs need a long, unhurried fermentation.

questions.q: Describe the method of adding fat in making croissants.
questions.answer: (i) Roll the dough into a rectangle about 8 mm thick. (ii) Cream 50 g butter or margarine and spread it over two-thirds of the length, leaving a 2 cm margin. (iii) Fold the unbuttered third over half of the buttered part and bring over the remaining part so that there are three layers of dough with two of fat. (iv) Seal the open edges with a rolling pin and roll again lightly so that the fat does not come out. (v) Repeat with the next two lots of 50 g fat and finally give a book fold.

questions.q: Write the steps of preparing doughnuts.
questions.answer: (i) Prepare a soft yeast dough with flour, sugar, salt, eggs and milk and knead until smooth and elastic. (ii) Let it rise until double and knock back. (iii) Roll it to 1/2 inch and cut with a doughnut cutter. (iv) Prove the doughnuts on a floured duster until double. (v) Deep fry in new oil until golden brown on both sides, drain and roll in cinnamon sugar.
